criteria.description: Every required fact remains visible; no invented implications or facts.
Structured parsing, unstructured inference and existing-diagram rendering stay distinct.
Meaningful text and reconstructable diagrams are editable, with no full-slide raster substitution.
The actual PowerPoint opens without repair and every slide renders correctly.

Native text is editable and major elements are independently movable; inspect native geometry/grouping. Record target-application probes separately; attached connectors are optional unless explicitly required.
Final contrast, reading order and text alternatives satisfy the applicable Folio acceptance rules.
The frozen plugin and recorded model, effort and execution surface were actually used.
Source region arrangement, reading order and grouping remain recognisable.
The architecture canvas and outcome illustrations retain explanatory role and relative visual weight. Illustrative internal geometry needs recognisability, not exact technical topology.
The headline does not expand at the expense of functional visuals.
Source and final slide have been compared at whole-slide and detail scale; deviations are recorded.
All source copy and repeated risk labels stay visible on the single slide.
Original typography, colours and illustration treatment are preserved without loading a design system.
